text: I was sceptical at first. because when you have the free version, it is very clear that most of the content is for people with a subscription. However, now I just might keep paying for the coming months. I have simultaniously started a physical journal with weekly and daily goals. I find that works better for me, as I generally don't spend *that* much time on my phone. As other people here have said: this app is probably more effective for people who are on their phone often. The biggest reason for me to keep using Fabulous are the "nightly coaching" and "focus coaching" sessions. The message is brought across in super satisfying way and often really hits home and encourages action. While seeming cringe at first, the inspiration nature really does work very well. The overall design is nice. But I'm often left feeling that I'm not using the app to it's full potential, because there is quite a bit to explore. This can definitely seem daunting during the first week or so. For me, the fact that future goals weren't visible from the beginning was a negative. However when going online to the fabulous website, I could see them and open them in my app. I can't do two goals at once (which I get) but it's also a bit frustrating that I can start a goal (or start a streak) from further down in the journey (with the external link). But then when I want to switch back to my original goas (from earlier on in the journey), the streak is gone. I wonder, is this perhaps a bug? And shouldn't it be made impossible to unlock (and skip past) steps on your Journey roadmap by clicking an external link?
